1: God sends Jonah to Nineveh. He sails the other way. A storm rises, the sailors throw him overboard, and a great fish swallows him.
2: Inside the fish Jonah prays, and after three days it spits him onto land.
Jesus calls this "the sign of Jonah", pointing to his three days in the tomb.
3: Jonah preaches, and the whole city, from king to cattle, fasts in sackcloth. God relents.
4: Jonah sulks because God was merciful. God gives him a shade plant, lets it wither, and asks why he pities a plant and not a great city.
God's mercy is wider than his prophet likes.
